name: Sink + window + content top-K
tagline: Block-sparse attention combining attention sinks, a local window covering ~45% of the budget, and a per-row content-adaptive top-K of distant blocks via mean-pooled QK scoring.

key_hyperparams.name: window_budget_frac
key_hyperparams.role: share of density budget reserved for local window

key_hyperparams.name: scoring
key_hyperparams.value: mean-pool QK per block, masked SDPA

diff_from_baseline: Combines streaming-llm sinks/window with block_topk-style content scoring: sinks and a budget-fraction local window are guaranteed, then mean-pool QK selects K_adapt extra distant blocks per query row to reach the global budget.

name: Subsampled max-mean block top-K
tagline: Score key blocks by per-query max-of-subsampled QK, then mean over query subsamples; sinks and local blocks are forced via score boosts before top-K.

key_hyperparams.name: score_aggregation
key_hyperparams.value: max over key, mean over query

diff_from_baseline: Replaces block_topk's mean-pooled scalar QK score with a max-mean reduction over 16 subsampled rays per block; force-includes sinks and 4 local blocks via score boosts inside the same top-K pass.

name: Sinks + key-energy anchors + window
tagline: Token-level mask: sinks plus energy-spread key anchors restricted to early query rows, with a local window sized to consume the remaining budget.

key_hyperparams.name: anchor_stride
key_hyperparams.role: bucket size for top-1 anchor selection

key_hyperparams.name: row_anchor_frac
key_hyperparams.role: share of early rows that see anchors

key_hyperparams.name: anchor_horizon
key_hyperparams.role: exclude very recent keys from anchor pool

diff_from_baseline: Generalises StreamingLLM by adding query-position-adaptive global anchors selected from key energy (stride-bucketed top-1) and only granting them to the first 45% of query rows, while solving the local window width from the leftover budget.

name: Static window + variance-adjusted top-K
tagline: Cached static (sinks + 384-token window) mask plus a content-adaptive block top-K combining mean-pooled QK with normalized key variance.

key_hyperparams.name: remaining_min
key_hyperparams.role: minimum budget reserved for adaptive blocks

key_hyperparams.name: shared_mask
key_hyperparams.role: single (N,N) adaptive mask broadcast to heads

diff_from_baseline: Hybrid of streaming_llm and block_topk: keeps a cached sinks+window static mask, adds block top-K whose score blends mean-pool QK with a normalized key-variance distinctiveness term, with budget split between static and adaptive components.

name: Sink + window + dilated stride
tagline: Block-level mask of one sink block, a 2-block window, and dilated past-block taps at multiples of stride=8 until the density budget is exhausted.

key_hyperparams.name: max_d
key_hyperparams.role: deepest dilation depth that still satisfies budget

diff_from_baseline: Generalises StreamingLLM by adding fixed dilated past-block taps (Sparse-Transformer-style strides) on top of sinks and a small window; greedy dilation depth selected to saturate the 25% budget.
